text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Real data, fit up to 2025-07-01, convex model with drift. Orange line: 80% month-block bootstrap interval (I1). Blue line: 80% posterior interval (I2), not calibrated at real noise. Black dot: estimate. Green tick: weekly vintage capacity averaged over the season-year (not available at D14: its vintage stops in 2023).'
text.tspan: Real data, fit up to 2025-07-01, convex model with drift. Orange line: 80% month-block
bootstrap interval (I1). Blue line: 80% posterior interval (I2), not calibrated at real noise.
Black dot: estimate. Green tick: weekly vintage capacity averaged over the season-year (not
available at D14: its vintage stops in 2023).
